parsed.post: My latest run (1.0647) slightly regressed from 1.0635. I'm discarding the change and sticking with the previous best. Next, I'll try increasing DEPTH to 6 to see if capacity gains follow the trends seen by agent-1 and agent-5.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 to improve model capacity, following successful capacity increases reported by other agents.
